subject: Trees Medford Small Grant Application
overview: The Community Preservation Committee approved a $10,000 small grant application for Trees Medford to inventory invasive plants across city parks. The committee also planned its FY27 cycle schedule, officer elections, and upcoming community engagement activities.

items.title: Meeting Minutes of December 9, 2025
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from December 9, 2025.

items.title: Upcoming Officer Elections
items.summary: The chair invited members to consider running for chair or vice chair positions ahead of elections scheduled for the following month.

items.title: Draft FY27 CPA Calendar and Policy
items.summary: Members reviewed the proposed 2026 CPA calendar and agreed to hold the annual public hearing in March, focusing invitations on key boards and municipal staff.

items.title: 2026 Public Engagement and Community Survey
items.summary: The committee discussed potential community tabling events and revised the upcoming annual survey, deciding to remove questions regarding preferred funding percentage allocations.

items.title: Trees Medford Small Grant Application
items.summary: Approved a $10,000 small grant recommendation for Trees Medford and Wilderscaping to inventory invasive plant species across city parks.
